context.scene_title: The gate gargoyles and a magic burst — Deling City parade, the moment of Edea's spellcasting/Iguion summoning (Disc 1).
locations: Deling City at night — the parade gate with the two flanking gargoyle (Iguion) statues and the central throne, then a blinding blue magical flash

characters.name: Iguion statues (x2)
characters.recognition: The fanged reptilian gargoyles perched on pink/purple drum-like pedestals on either side of the gate, framing the empty throne.

characters.name: Sorceress Edea (implied)
characters.recognition: Not directly shown; the blue magical burst is consistent with her spellcasting at the gate.

context.summary: A symmetrical view shows the parade gate flanked by the two reptilian gargoyle statues and the central throne under a starry night sky. The shot then erupts into a brilliant blue magical flash — the energy of Edea's spell (the Iguion summoning / her magic during the parade).
context.context_note: High confidence on the gate/Iguion imagery; the blue flash is interpreted as Edea's magic, but the exact spell beat is inferred.
